description: This file is a PHP class that implements an OpenCart admin controller for managing user permissions, including listing, editing, creating, and deleting user groups and their associated permissions.

classes.name: UserPermission
classes.description: Controller class for managing user group permissions within the OpenCart admin panel.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Displays the main permission management page with user group listing.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Handles the request to list user groups, returning the list view.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Fetches and renders the list of user groups with pagination.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Displays the form to create or edit a user group and its permissions.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Processes form submission to save new or updated user group data.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes selected user groups, with permission checks and user count validation.
